author: KevineCove
body: You will definitely take a hit in PvP but the sooner you hit T10 the sooner you can start accumulating the best endgame gear. I recommend hitting T10 as soon as possible, even if it means a friend boosting you to that tier before your gear is ready for it. Having access to all classes and all gear is so much more important than any temporary setbacks.

author: PlaysByBrulesRules
body:
Is it Sir Oinksworth 😭?

Also, try to save up as many tower shards as you can. I’d advise you to Godforge the best Venin you have (or two). If you use a magic build then Arisen Witches staff. 

Stacking EXP equipment buffs will be your best way to grind levels out. Look out for Arisen Monster Tomes that drop off of Arisen Fafnir at T10, those have the highest exp buffs for accessory slot.
